<!-- pr-reviewer: 62d8b7dd3b8dd3e7744d693a9fb527c76d36153f -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one safety-of-the-gate regression; reviewed only what #1033 adds over #972).

**What looks good**
- `path_mods::included_as` resolves a `#[path]` file against the includer's own directory, handles `mod x;` and `pub(...) mod x;` with intervening attributes, and maps to `(parent, name)`, with `mod`/`tests` includers falling back to the declared name. The target case works.
- `PROCESS_VERSION` is 20, correct after the stack (#965=17, #967=18, #972=19). SKULL's #991 also lands on 20, so whichever merges later renumbers.
- Provenance line, decision file (`docs/decisions/1021-path-included-modules.md`), `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1021` are all present. No snapshot PNGs, no new dependencies.

**Local results** (merged-state not needed: the PR only touches xtask/docs and its base is #972)
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 44 passed, 0 failed (including `a_path_included_file_selects_its_parents_submodule_suites`).
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `--dry-run` for a one-line change to `crates/app/src/posting_index_swing.rs`:
  - before: `src app::posting_index_swing -> 0 suite(s) by gate map (module)`, plan runs only `app lib`.
  - after: `src app::posting::index_swing -> 1 suite(s) by gate map (submodule)`, plan adds `app:index_swing`.

I also compared old vs new quick selection for all 56 `#[path]`-included files in the tree (touching each, `--dry-run` with the base xtask and the PR xtask).

**Requested before merge**
1. The new mapping selects fewer suites than before for some files, because three suite headers still use the old file-name spelling. The old plan matched them, the new one does not:
   - `crates/app/src/posting_sim.rs`: loses `wall_column_gouge` (`crates/app/tests/wall_column_gouge.rs:11` names `app::posting_sim`; also `contour_arc_sim.rs:16`).
   - `crates/app/src/posting_suppressed.rs`: loses `rest_across_setups` (`crates/app/tests/rest_across_setups.rs:12` names `app::posting_suppressed`).
   - `crates/app/src/posting_plasma.rs` gains the right suite, but `plasma_gate.rs:12` also uses the `app::posting_plasma` spelling (check it still lands).
   Fix either way: make `included_as` return both the old file-stem spelling and the parent submodule (union, so it can never select fewer), or rewrite those headers to `app::posting (sim)` / `(suppressed)` / `(plasma)` and add a pin that reads the real headers like the #922 pins do. The union is the safer default.
2. Related narrowing to confirm is intended: `*_tests.rs` files included by `#[path]` now select far fewer suites (`drill_reach_tests.rs` 122 -> 6, `spindle_law_tests.rs` 122 -> 5, `turning_rapids_tests.rs` 122 -> 3, post `tooling_tests.rs` 44 -> 1 app suites). The old numbers were an accidental fallback to the whole parent module, so the new ones are more precise, but they are fewer; say so in the decision file if kept.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `included_as` greps raw text, so a `#[path = "x.rs"]` inside a comment or string in a sibling would be taken as an include (and the first alphabetical sibling wins). A line-comment/string strip before the regex would match the stated intent; today it cannot select fewer than a real include, but it can pick the wrong parent.
- `#[path]` inside an inline `mod a { ... }` resolves against `dir/a/` and is not handled; the decision file says so and none exist today.
- The `xtask/src/` files are well under 400 lines.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a1a4eec4740185a97a47a053e26b764f3931a969 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (delta review of a1a4eec4, against the earlier needs-rework at 62d8b7dd).

**What looks good**
- `included_as` now returns the union of the file-stem spelling and the parent submodule, so the change can only add suites.
- `#[path]` text inside `//` comments is ignored.
- The decision file (`docs/decisions/1021-path-included-modules.md`) records the union and why the first cut narrowed. The `*_tests.rs` narrowing no longer exists, so there is nothing left to justify.
- `PROCESS_VERSION` is bumped.

**Local results** (trial merge with current upstream main, clean)
- Every one of the 56 `#[path]`-included files was touched in turn. `cargo xtask gate quick --base HEAD --dry-run` was run with the base xtask (#972 head) and the new one on the same tree. The new suite/crate/test-fn set is a superset of the old for all 56. There are no exceptions.
- Confirmed with the new xtask:
  - `posting_sim.rs` selects `wall_column_gouge`, `contour_arc_sim` and `plasma_gate`.
  - `posting_suppressed.rs` selects `rest_across_setups`.
  - `posting_plasma.rs` selects `plasma_gate`.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 44 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**: only the xtask crate and the decision file changed, so the app and ui suites were not built.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
